name: Wither
text: When resolving a Combat Encounter, you may test Lore. If you pass, gain +3 Strength during that encounter. Then flip this card.
flavor: Speak the syllable that turns bone to ash.

action.text: Cast Wither: test Lore. Pass: each Monster here loses 2 Health. Then flip this card.

backs.text: The word sears your throat. Lose 1 Sanity.
Your mastery holds firm.

name: Flesh Ward
text: Once per round, when an investigator would lose Health, you may test Lore. If you pass, prevent that investigator from losing up to 2 Health. Then flip this card.
flavor: Invisible plates of force interpose themselves before the blow.

action.text: Cast Flesh Ward: test Lore. Pass: recover 2 Health. Then flip this card.

backs.text: The ward shatters violently! Lose 1 Sanity and discard Flesh Ward.
The ward settles cleanly over your skin.

name: Mists of Releh
text: During the Encounter Phase, you may test Lore. If you pass, you may choose an encounter as if there are no Monsters on your space. Then flip this card.
flavor: A grey fog rises from nowhere to hide your steps.

action.text: Cast Mists of Releh: test Lore. Pass: move 1 space. Then flip this card.

backs.text: Something moves in the mist beside you. Lose 1 Sanity.
The mist parts on a clear road.

name: Shriveling
text: Action: Test Lore. If you pass, choose a Monster on your space to lose 2 Health. Then flip this card.
flavor: Black lightning leaps from your outstretched fingers.

action.text: Cast Shriveling: test Lore (-1). Pass: Monsters here lose 3 Health. Then flip this card.

backs.text: The backlash tears at your mind! Lose 2 Sanity.
The air smells of ozone, but your mind is whole.

name: Blessing of Isis
text: Action: Test Lore-1. If you pass, choose an investigator on your space that does not have a Blessed Condition to gain a Blessed Condition. Then flip this card.
flavor: An ancient invocation of the winged goddess.

action.text: Cast Blessing of Isis: test Lore (-1). Pass: an investigator here gains Blessed. Then flip this card.

backs.text: The goddess turns her face away. Lose 1 Sanity and discard this Spell.
Golden light warms the room.

name: Clairvoyance
text: During the Encounter Phase, you may test Lore. If you pass, you may choose to encounter a Clue as if you are on its space, ignoring Monsters on that space. Then flip this card.
flavor: Close your eyes and see what lies hidden across the sea.

action.text: Cast Clairvoyance: test Lore (-1). Pass: gain 1 Clue. Then flip this card.

backs.text: Something in the vision looks back at you! Lose 1 Sanity.
The vision fades without harm.

name: Plumb the Void
text: Action: Test Lore-1. If you pass, an investigator of your choice may move to any space. Then flip this card.
flavor: Whisper a question into the dark between stars.

action.text: Cast Plumb the Void: test Lore (-1). Pass: spawn 1 Clue and gain 1 Clue. Then flip this card.

backs.text: The void answers with a scream. Lose 2 Sanity.
You pull your mind back in time.

name: Conjuration
text: Action: Test Lore+1. If you pass, you may gain 1 Item or Trinket Asset from the reserve with value equal to or less than your test result. Then flip this card.

action.text: Cast Conjuration: test Lore (+1). Pass: gain 1 Item or Trinket Asset from the reserve. Then flip this card.

backs.text: The spell slips away from you. Lose 1 Sanity.
The casting holds.

name: Feed the Mind
text: Action: Test Lore-1. If you pass, choose an investigator on your space to improve 1 skill of his choice. Then flip this card.

action.text: Cast Feed the Mind: test Lore (-1). Pass: an investigator here improves 1 skill. Then flip this card.

backs.text: The spell slips away from you. Lose 1 Sanity.
The casting holds.

name: Instill Bravery
text: Once per round, when an investigator would lose Sanity, you may test Lore. If you pass, prevent that investigator from losing up to 2 Sanity. Then flip this card.

action.text: Cast Instill Bravery: test Lore. Pass: an investigator here recovers 2 Sanity. Then flip this card.

backs.text: The spell slips away from you. Lose 1 Sanity.
The casting holds.
